cohort: 145 patients who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for PAS at a referral center
finding: This study identified gestational age at delivery, number of vaginal bleeding episodes, and emergent delivery as independent predictors of ICU admission after cesarean hysterectomy for PAS, with a model incorporating these variables demonstrating good predictive accuracy.
gest_age: Mean gestational age: 34 weeks for ICU admission group vs. 35 weeks for routine recovery care group
